Now open at 25 Harbour Quay…

Ultimate Performance Wood Wharf gives you ‘the best personal training experience on the planet’.   

We have helped over 25,000 clients worldwide achieve life-changing transformations.   

Our ‘maximum results, minimum time’ model means you need just 2.7 hours of personal training per week to achieve exceptional results. Whether you want to lose fat, build muscle or transform your health.  

No matter what your age, ability or fitness levels, you will achieve results you never believed possible in partnership with the world’s leading trainers.  

We tailor a personal training and diet plan to you with 150+ data points. We stand as your trusted advisor, supporting you inside and outside the gym. We keep you accountable, maximise your every training session and give you the round-the-clock expertise you need to excel.   

Our team track every progress metric possible with our app technology – from body fat to blood pressure – to give you measurable results and return on investment.    

This is personal training on a whole different level. Learn how you can transform your body, your health and your lifestyle with our expert team at www.ultimateperformance.com

Sessions outside of standard gym opening hours can be arranged by appointment.

Work with Ultimate Performance in their second private personal training gym in Canary Wharf.

You’ll find ‘the world’s best personal training experience’ at Level 2, Cabot Place West, two years on from the launch of U.P. Wood Wharf.

Following the huge demand and incredible success of U.P. Wood Wharf, they’re giving even more people the opportunity to partner with some of the leading personal trainers on the planet.

Trainers who are incentivised to do just one thing; deliver the best possible results for you.

U.P.’s time-tested methods proven with 25,000+ clients, mean that if you commit to the process, you will achieve life-changing results no matter your age, ability, or starting point.

You might think you need to spend hours in the gym every week, but that’s not true. U.P.’s ‘maximum results, minimum time’ model means you need an average of just 2.7 hours of gym time every week to get results. It’s personal training like you’ve never seen before.

Start your own transformation today: https://ultimateperformance.com/
